text:
dana: Quick sync 19:00 UTC change window for a multi-service flip (api/runtime/router/console). Need pins, one-line rollback plan, and ops checklist.

deploybot: Scheduled 19:00 UTC. Canary path: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Will run 10m holds at each jump.

jess: What are exact versions and fallbacks?

dana: api v3.10.1 (minor auth fix), runtime v2.14.2 (batch mem tweak), router v1.9.2 (weighted headers), console v0.28.6. Fallbacks: api v3.10.0, runtime v2.14.1, router v1.9.1, console toggle to USE_NEW_TRACES=false.

oncall: infra note: ap-southeast-1 has node drain scheduled 20:15-20:45 UTC. Avoid promoting full regional traffic before 20:50.

dana: Thanks. We'll limit regional shift. Jess will own rollback signal; ops will own router split rollback.

jess: Rollback gates proposed: API 5xx >3% for 5m, runtime p50 token latency +300ms, router 5xx spike detected by synthetic, console frontend error rate >1.2%. If hit, tag thread with #rollback and call deploybot revert.

deploybot: Preflight passed (health checks green, no migrations). Canary groups created. Adding gates to release metadata.

jess: Ops snippet for router split to apply during canary: ```yaml
split_rules:
  header: x-routing
  routes:
    - id: legacy
      weight: 85
    - id: new
      weight: 15
```

infra-bot: Reminder: don't exceed 60% CPU on ap-southeast until node-drain completes.

dana: Note: console will keep NEW_TRACES disabled for first two groups. We'll enable only after 40% and verify trace continuity.

deploybot: Canary started (19:00 UTC) -> group-1 at 2%. Health probes running.

jess: Quick smoke: login ok, embeddings ok. Watching error budget.

oncall: Observing token-cache miss at +4% baseline, allowed.

jess: After 10m, promote to 10% (19:12 UTC).

deploybot: Promoted to 10% -> holding.

jess: Metrics stable. Promoting to 40% (19:25 UTC). Turning on console traces flag in canary for 40% only.

infra-bot: Canaries in ap-southeast limited to 30% due to drain.

dana: Good catch. Keep global promotion but respect regional caps.

jess: 40% hold looks clean; no gate breaches. Enabling console traces for canary fraction.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% at 19:40 UTC with regional caps applied.

jess: All signals green. No rollback needed.

dana: Postmortem windows: monitor for 24h. If regression, we'll trigger staged rollback: 1) deploybot revert to pinned artifacts, 2) ops revert router split, 3) toggle console traces off, 4) redeploy runtime pinned.

oncall: Acknowledged. Closing thread unless any anomalies reported. :white_check_mark:
